ko.title: 14개월째 지속되는 둔화: 최근 주택 가격 데이터가 말해주는 미국 주택 시장의 열기 식히기

segments.src: ## A Streak Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## 주목할 만한 연속 기록

segments.src: The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index — one of the most closely followed gauges of residential real estate in the United States — has now recorded its 14th consecutive month of decelerating annual price growth.
segments.tr: 미국 주거용 부동산의 가장 주목받는 지표 중 하나인 S&P 코탈리티 케이스-실러 주택가격지수(S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index)가 14개월 연속으로 연간 가격 상승률 둔화를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: That doesn't mean home prices are falling across the board; in most metro areas, values are still higher than they were a year ago.
segments.tr: 이것이 주택 가격이 전반적으로 하락하고 있다는 의미는 아닙니다. 대부분의 대도시 지역에서 주택 가치는 여전히 1년 전보다 높습니다.

segments.src: What has changed is the *pace*.
segments.tr: 변화한 것은 바로 *속도*입니다.

segments.src: Year-over-year gains have been shrinking steadily since the market's 2023 slowdown, and the latest reading puts growth at its slowest clip in that entire stretch.
segments.tr: 전년 대비 상승 폭은 2023년 시장 둔화 이후 꾸준히 줄어들고 있으며, 최근 수치는 이 기간을 통틀어 가장 느린 성장 속도를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: 팬데믹 기간의 대부분을 기록 경신으로 보낸 주택 시장에 있어, 14개월 연속 열기가 식어가는 것은 주목할 만한 이정표입니다.

segments.src: It suggests the combination of elevated mortgage rates, affordability strain, and a slow rebuild in housing supply is finally working its way through the numbers in a sustained, not just seasonal, way.
segments.tr: 이는 높은 모기지 금리, 감당하기 힘든 주택 가격 부담, 그리고 느린 주택 공급 회복세가 결합되어 마침내 일시적인 계절적 현상이 아닌 지속적인 방식으로 수치에 반영되고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters
segments.tr: ## 이 지수가 중요한 이유

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: 케이스-실러 지수는 시간이 흐름에 따라 동일한 주택의 반복 매매를 추적하므로, 특정 월에 어떤 주택이 거래되었는지에 따라 왜곡될 수 있는 단순 중간 판매 가격 스냅샷보다 근본적인 가격 추세를 더 신뢰할 수 있게 측정합니다.

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: 경제학자, 모기지 대출 기관, 연방준비제도 모두가 이 지수를 예의주시하고 있습니다. 주택 가격이 가계 자산, 소비자 신뢰도, 그리고 자가주거비(owners' equivalent rent) 계산을 통해 인플레이션 데이터 자체에 직접적인 영향을 미치기 때문입니다.

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: 이 지수의 성장률이 1년 넘게 연속으로 둔화할 때는 보통 두 가지 중 하나를 의미합니다. 소득 대비 주택 가격이 너무 비싸져서 구매자가 물러서고 있거나, 높아진 대출 비용으로 인해 수요가 충분히 줄어들어 판매자가 가격 경쟁을 더 치열하게 해야 하는 상황입니다.

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: 이 주기를 추적하는 대부분의 분석가들은 이 두 가지 요인이 복합적으로 작용하고 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## 모기지 금리라는 배경

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: 모기지 금리는 주택 소유자들이 2020년과 2021년에 고정해 둔 초저금리 수준을 훨씬 웃돌고 있으며, 이 격차가 이러한 냉각 추세의 배후에서 큰 역할을 하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: 수백만 명의 기존 주택 소유자들은 현재 이용 가능한 금리보다 몇 퍼센트 포인트 낮은 금리의 모기지를 유지하고 있어, 집을 팔고 이사할 유인이 거의 없습니다. 이를 흔히 '잠금 효과(lock-in effect)'라고 부릅니다.

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 구매자 수요가 약화되는 와중에도 매물 재고가 부족하게 유지되며, 이는 대부분의 지역에서 가격이 급락하기보다 상승세가 둔화하는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: 한편, 예비 구매자들은 불과 몇 년 전과는 매우 달라진 월 납입금 계산법에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: 작년과 가격이 같은 주택이라도 금융 비용을 고려하면 오늘날 체감하는 부담은 훨씬 더 클 수 있으며, 이러한 셈법은 잠재적 구매자 중 일부를 시장에서 이탈시키기에 충분했습니다.

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## 신축 주택 판매가 더하는 또 다른 데이터 포인트

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: 이번 주의 신축 주택 판매 보고서는 케이스-실러 지수 업데이트와 동시에 발표되었으며, 이 두 가지는 함께 시장의 더 완전한 그림을 그려줍니다.

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: 기존 주택 소유자와 달리 건설업체는 금리 환경에 관계없이 판매해야 할 강력한 유인이 있기 때문에, 신축 주택은 구매자 수요를 해소하는 점점 더 중요한 탈출구가 되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: 많은 건설업체가 계약을 지속하기 위해 모기지 금리 인하 지원(buydown) 및 가격 할인과 같은 인센티브에 의존해 왔으며, 이는 광범위한 기존 주택 시장이 식어가는 와중에도 신축 주택 판매가 버텨내는 데 도움이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: 두 보고서를 함께 살펴보면, 몇 년간의 과열 이후 단순히 균형을 찾아가는 시장과 실제 균열이 나타나고 있는 시장을 구분하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: 지금까지 대부분의 주택 경제학자들은 현재 환경을 2008년 침체의 재현이라기보다는 점진적인 정상화 과정으로 설명하며, 당시와의 주요 차이점으로 더 건전해진 대출 기준과 지속적인 구조적 주택 부족을 꼽고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## 지역적 차이가 진짜 이야기

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.
segments.tr: 전국 평균은 많은 지역적 편차를 가릴 수 있으며, 지금이 특히 그렇습니다.

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.
segments.tr: 팬데믹 기간 동안 폭발적인 가격 상승을 보였던 일부 선벨트(Sun Belt) 및 마운틴 웨스트(Mountain West) 대도시 지역(플로리다, 텍사스, 애리조나 일부 시장 등)은 가장 많이 냉각되었으며, 팬데믹 이후 이주 패턴이 정상화되고 새로운 공급이 수요를 따라잡으면서 일부 사례에서는 완만한 가격 하락세를 보이기도 했습니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: 반면, 재고가 더 타이트하게 유지된 북동부 및 중서부의 많은 시장은 눈부시지는 않더라도 계속해서 더 안정적인 연간 상승세를 기록하고 있습니다.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: 이러한 차이는 전국적인 헤드라인을 자신의 지역 시장과 비교해 보려는 누구에게나 중요합니다.

segments.src: A slowing national index doesn't necessarily mean prices are softening in every city, and buyers or sellers should look at local inventory and days-on-market data rather than relying on national averages alone.
segments.tr: 전국 지수의 둔화가 모든 도시에서 가격이 약화되고 있음을 의미하는 것은 아니므로, 구매자나 판매자는 전국 평균에만 의존하기보다 지역 재고 및 매물 적체 기간(days-on-market) 데이터를 살펴보아야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 의미

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: 14개월 연속 성장 둔화가 앞으로 시장이 어디로 갈지 보장하지는 않습니다. 점진적으로 계속 식어갈 수도 있고, 더 느린 속도로 안정화될 수도 있으며, 모기지 금리가 의미 있게 인하될 경우 다시 가속화될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: 확실한 것은 팬데믹 시절의 이례적인 가격 상승이 훨씬 더 차분한 환경으로 바뀌었다는 점이며, 이 환경은 입찰 경쟁보다는 가격 부담 한계, 금융 비용, 그리고 지역별 수급 역학에 의해 형성되고 있습니다.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: 구매자에게 이러한 변화는 몇 년 전보다 더 많은 협상 여지와 복수 제안 상황의 감소를 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: 판매자에게는 더 이상 과열되지 않은 시장에서 작년의 비교 사례를 쫓기보다 주택 가격을 현실적으로 책정하는 것이 더 중요하다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.
segments.tr: 그리고 경제 전반으로 볼 때, 갑작스러운 균열이 아니라 점진적으로 식어가는 주택 부문은 대부분의 기준에서 위기로 향하는 시장이 아니라 제자리를 찾아가는 시장의 신호입니다.

hi.title: 14 महीने और गिनती जारी: नवीनतम आवास-मूल्य डेटा अमेरिका के ठंडे होते आवास बाजार के बारे में क्या कहता है

segments.src: ## A Streak Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## एक सिलसिला जिस पर ध्यान देना जरूरी है

segments.src: The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index — one of the most closely followed gauges of residential real estate in the United States — has now recorded its 14th consecutive month of decelerating annual price growth.
segments.tr: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller होम प्राइस इंडेक्स — जो संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में आवासीय अचल संपत्ति के सबसे बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले पैमानों में से एक है — ने अब वार्षिक मूल्य वृद्धि में लगातार 14वें महीने गिरावट दर्ज की है।

segments.src: That doesn't mean home prices are falling across the board; in most metro areas, values are still higher than they were a year ago.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि घरों की कीमतें हर जगह गिर रही हैं; अधिकांश मेट्रो क्षेत्रों में, कीमतें अभी भी एक साल पहले की तुलना में अधिक हैं।

segments.src: What has changed is the *pace*.
segments.tr: जो बदला है वह है *गति*।

segments.src: Year-over-year gains have been shrinking steadily since the market's 2023 slowdown, and the latest reading puts growth at its slowest clip in that entire stretch.
segments.tr: बाजार में 2023 की सुस्ती के बाद से साल-दर-साल लाभ लगातार कम हो रहा है, और नवीनतम रीडिंग इस पूरी अवधि में विकास को सबसे धीमी गति पर रखती है।

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: महामारी के दौर में रिकॉर्ड बनाने वाले आवास बाजार के लिए, 14 महीने तक ठंडा पड़ना एक उल्लेखनीय मील का पत्थर है।

segments.src: It suggests the combination of elevated mortgage rates, affordability strain, and a slow rebuild in housing supply is finally working its way through the numbers in a sustained, not just seasonal, way.
segments.tr: यह बताता है कि बढ़ी हुई बंधक दरों (mortgage rates), सामर्थ्य के दबाव और आवास आपूर्ति में धीमी रिकवरी का संयोजन आखिरकार आंकड़ों में एक निरंतर, न कि केवल मौसमी, तरीके से काम कर रहा है।

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters
segments.tr: ## सूचकांक क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: Case-Shiller सूचकांक समय के साथ एक ही घरों की बार-बार होने वाली बिक्री को ट्रैक करता है, जो इसे अंतर्निहित मूल्य रुझानों का एक अधिक विश्वसनीय माप बनाता है, बजाय साधारण औसत-बिक्री-मूल्य स्नैपशॉट के, जो इस बात से प्रभावित हो सकते हैं कि किसी विशेष महीने में कौन से घर बिकते हैं।

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री, बंधक ऋणदाता (mortgage lenders), और फेडरल रिजर्व सभी इसे बारीकी से देखते हैं क्योंकि घरों की कीमतें सीधे घरेलू संपत्ति, उपभोक्ता विश्वास और — मालिकों के समतुल्य किराए की गणना के माध्यम से — मुद्रास्फीति डेटा को प्रभावित करती हैं।

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: जब सूचकांक की विकास दर लगातार एक साल से अधिक समय तक धीमी हो जाती है, तो यह आमतौर पर दो चीजों में से एक का संकेत देता है: या तो खरीदार पीछे हट रहे हैं क्योंकि आय की तुलना में घर बहुत महंगे हो गए हैं, या उधार लेने की उच्च लागत इतनी मांग को कम कर रही है कि विक्रेताओं को कीमत पर अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धा करनी पड़ती है।

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: इस चक्र का अनुसरण करने वाले अधिकांश विश्लेषक दोनों के मिश्रण की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## बंधक दर की पृष्ठभूमि

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: बंधक दरें उन बेहद कम स्तरों से काफी ऊपर बनी हुई हैं जिन्हें घर के मालिकों ने 2020 और 2021 के दौरान लॉक किया था, और यह अंतर इस ठंडे होते रुझान के पीछे बहुत बड़ा काम कर रहा है।

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: लाखों मौजूदा घर के मालिक ऐसे बंधक पर बैठे हैं जिनकी दरें आज उपलब्ध दरों से कई अंक नीचे हैं, जिससे उन्हें बेचने और स्थानांतरित होने के लिए बहुत कम प्रोत्साहन मिलता है — एक घटना जिसे अक्सर "लॉक-इन प्रभाव" कहा जाता है।

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: यह पुनर्विक्रय इन्वेंट्री को तंग रखता है, भले ही खरीदार की मांग नरम हो रही हो, जो आंशिक रूप से कारण है कि अधिकांश क्षेत्रों में कीमतें तेजी से गिरने के बजाय धीमी हो रही हैं।

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: इस बीच, संभावित खरीदार मासिक भुगतान की गणना का सामना कर रहे हैं जो कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में बहुत अलग दिखती है।

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: पिछले साल की तरह कीमत वाला घर आज वित्तपोषण लागत को शामिल करने के बाद काफी कम किफायती हो सकता है, और यह गणित संभावित खरीदारों के एक हिस्से को किनारे करने के लिए पर्याप्त रहा है।

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## नए घरों की बिक्री एक और डेटा बिंदु जोड़ती है

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: इस सप्ताह की नए घरों की बिक्री की रिपोर्ट Case-Shiller अपडेट के साथ ही आती है, और दोनों मिलकर बाजार की अधिक पूर्ण तस्वीर पेश करते हैं।

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: नया निर्माण खरीदार की मांग के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण रिलीज वाल्व बन गया है, क्योंकि बिल्डरों के पास — मौजूदा घर के मालिकों के विपरीत — दर के माहौल की परवाह किए बिना बेचने के लिए मजबूत प्रोत्साहन है।

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: कई लोगों ने अनुबंधों को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए बंधक-दर बायडाउन (mortgage-rate buydowns) और मूल्य रियायतों जैसे प्रोत्साहनों का सहारा लिया है, जिसने व्यापक पुनर्विक्रय बाजार के ठंडा होने के बावजूद नए घरों की बिक्री को बनाए रखने में मदद की है।

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: दोनों रिपोर्टों को एक साथ देखने से उस बाजार के बीच अंतर करने में मदद मिलती है जो कई वर्षों के अधिक गर्म होने के बाद केवल पुनर्संतुलन कर रहा है और वह जो वास्तविक दरारें दिखा रहा है।

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: अब तक, अधिकांश आवास अर्थशास्त्री मौजूदा माहौल को 2008 की मंदी की पुनरावृत्ति के बजाय एक क्रमिक सामान्यीकरण के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं, जो उस युग से प्रमुख अंतर के रूप में स्वस्थ ऋण मानकों और घरों की निरंतर संरचनात्मक कमी की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## क्षेत्रीय विचलन ही असली कहानी है

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रीय औसत बहुत सारे स्थानीय बदलावों को छिपा सकते हैं, और यह अभी विशेष रूप से सच है।

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.
segments.tr: कुछ सन बेल्ट और माउंटेन वेस्ट मेट्रो क्षेत्रों में, जिन्होंने महामारी के दौरान विस्फोटक मूल्य वृद्धि देखी — फ्लोरिडा, टेक्सास और एरिज़ोना के कुछ हिस्सों जैसे बाजार — सबसे अधिक ठंडे हुए हैं और, कुछ मामलों में, मामूली मूल्य गिरावट देखी है क्योंकि महामारी के बाद के प्रवास पैटर्न सामान्य हो रहे हैं और नई आपूर्ति मांग के साथ तालमेल बिठा रही है।

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: इस बीच, पूर्वोत्तर और मध्य-पश्चिम के कई बाजार, जहां इन्वेंट्री तंग बनी हुई है, स्थिर — यदि शानदार नहीं — वार्षिक लाभ पोस्ट करना जारी रखते हैं।

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: यह विचलन उन सभी के लिए मायने रखता है जो राष्ट्रीय सुर्खियों को अपने स्थानीय बाजार के संदर्भ में पढ़ने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।

segments.tr: धीमी होती राष्ट्रीय सूचकांक का मतलब यह नहीं है कि हर शहर में कीमतें नरम हो रही हैं, और खरीदारों या विक्रेताओं को केवल राष्ट्रीय औसत पर भरोसा करने के बजाय स्थानीय इन्वेंट्री और बाजार में दिनों के डेटा को देखना चाहिए।

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## आगे इसका क्या मतलब है

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: लगातार चौदह महीने की धीमी विकास दर यह गारंटी नहीं देती है कि बाजार आगे कहां जाएगा — यह धीरे-धीरे ठंडा होता रह सकता है, धीमी गति पर स्थिर हो सकता है, या यदि बंधक दरें काफी कम हो जाती हैं तो फिर से तेज हो सकता है।

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: यह जो पुष्टि करता है वह यह है कि महामारी के वर्षों की असाधारण मूल्य वृद्धि ने एक बहुत अधिक मापा वातावरण को रास्ता दिया है, जो बोली युद्धों (bidding wars) से कम और सामर्थ्य सीमा, वित्तपोषण लागत और स्थानीयकृत आपूर्ति-और-मांग गतिशीलता से अधिक आकार का है।

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: खरीदारों के लिए, उस बदलाव का मतलब कुछ साल पहले की तुलना में अधिक बातचीत की गुंजाइश और कम बहु-प्रस्ताव स्थितियों का मतलब हो सकता है।

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: विक्रेताओं के लिए, यह एक अनुस्मारक है कि घर की कीमत को यथार्थवादी रूप से तय करना — पिछले साल की तुलनाओं का पीछा करने के बजाय — ऐसे बाजार में अधिक मायने रखता है जो अब गर्म नहीं चल रहा है।

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.

es.title: 14 meses y sumando: qué dicen los últimos datos sobre los precios de la vivienda acerca del enfriamiento del mercado inmobiliario en Estados Unidos

segments.src: ## A Streak Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Una racha digna de atención

segments.src: The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index — one of the most closely followed gauges of residential real estate in the United States — has now recorded its 14th consecutive month of decelerating annual price growth.
segments.tr: El S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index —uno de los indicadores de bienes raíces residenciales más seguidos en Estados Unidos— ha registrado su décimo cuarto mes consecutivo de desaceleración en el crecimiento anual de los precios.

segments.src: That doesn't mean home prices are falling across the board; in most metro areas, values are still higher than they were a year ago.
segments.tr: Eso no significa que los precios de las viviendas estén bajando de forma generalizada; en la mayoría de las áreas metropolitanas, los valores siguen siendo más altos que hace un año.

segments.src: What has changed is the *pace*.
segments.tr: Lo que ha cambiado es el *ritmo*.

segments.src: Year-over-year gains have been shrinking steadily since the market's 2023 slowdown, and the latest reading puts growth at its slowest clip in that entire stretch.
segments.tr: Las ganancias interanuales se han ido reduciendo de manera constante desde la desaceleración del mercado en 2023, y la última lectura sitúa el crecimiento en su nivel más lento de todo ese periodo.

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: Para un mercado de la vivienda que pasó gran parte de la era de la pandemia estableciendo récords, una racha de enfriamiento de 14 meses es un hito notable.

segments.src: It suggests the combination of elevated mortgage rates, affordability strain, and a slow rebuild in housing supply is finally working its way through the numbers in a sustained, not just seasonal, way.
segments.tr: Sugiere que la combinación de tasas hipotecarias elevadas, la presión sobre la asequibilidad y una recuperación lenta en la oferta de viviendas finalmente está surtiendo efecto en las cifras de manera sostenida, y no solo estacional.

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa el índice

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: El índice Case-Shiller rastrea las ventas repetidas de las mismas viviendas a lo largo del tiempo, lo que lo convierte en una medida más confiable de las tendencias de precios subyacentes que las simples instantáneas de precios de venta medianos, las cuales pueden verse sesgadas por las casas que se venden en un mes determinado.

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: Los economistas, los prestamistas hipotecarios y la Reserva Federal lo siguen de cerca porque los precios de la vivienda influyen directamente en la riqueza de los hogares, la confianza del consumidor y —a través de los cálculos del equivalente de alquiler de los propietarios— en los propios datos de inflación.

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: Cuando la tasa de crecimiento del índice se desacelera durante más de un año seguido, normalmente indica una de dos cosas: o los compradores se están retirando porque las viviendas se han vuelto demasiado caras en relación con los ingresos, o los mayores costos de endeudamiento están excluyendo a la demanda lo suficiente como para que los vendedores tengan que competir más en precio.

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los analistas que siguen este ciclo apuntan a una mezcla de ambas.

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## El telón de fondo de las tasas hipotecarias

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: Las tasas hipotecarias se han mantenido muy por encima de los niveles ultrabajos que los propietarios aseguraron en 2020 y 2021, y esa brecha está haciendo gran parte del trabajo detrás de esta tendencia de enfriamiento.

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: Millones de propietarios actuales tienen hipotecas con tasas varios puntos por debajo de las disponibles hoy en día, lo que les da pocos incentivos para vender y mudarse, un fenómeno a menudo llamado el "efecto de bloqueo".

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: Eso mantiene el inventario de reventa ajustado incluso cuando la demanda de los compradores se suaviza, lo cual es parte de la razón por la cual los precios se están desacelerando en lugar de caer bruscamente en la mayoría de las regiones.

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, los compradores potenciales se enfrentan a un cálculo de pago mensual que se ve muy diferente al de hace apenas unos años.

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: Una casa con el mismo precio que el año pasado aún puede ser significativamente menos asequible hoy una vez que se toman en cuenta los costos de financiamiento, y esa matemática ha sido suficiente para marginar a una porción de los compradores potenciales.

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## Las ventas de viviendas nuevas añaden otro punto de datos

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: El informe de ventas de viviendas nuevas de esta semana llega justo al lado de la actualización de Case-Shiller, y juntos ambos pintan un cuadro más completo del mercado.

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: La nueva construcción se ha convertido en una válvula de escape cada vez más importante para la demanda de los compradores, ya que los constructores —a diferencia de los propietarios actuales— tienen un fuerte incentivo para vender independientemente del entorno de tasas.

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: Muchos se han apoyado en incentivos como la reducción temporal de tasas hipotecarias y concesiones de precios para mantener los contratos en marcha, lo que ha ayudado a que las ventas de viviendas nuevas se mantengan incluso mientras el mercado de reventa en general se enfría.

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: Observar los dos informes juntos ayuda a distinguir entre un mercado que simplemente se está reequilibrando después de varios años de sobrecalentamiento y uno que muestra grietas genuinas.

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: Hasta ahora, la mayoría de los economistas inmobiliarios describen el entorno actual como una normalización gradual en lugar de una repetición de la recesión de 2008, señalando normas de préstamo más saludables y una persistente escasez estructural de viviendas como diferencias clave con esa era.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## La divergencia regional es la verdadera historia

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.
segments.tr: Los promedios nacionales pueden oscurecer una gran cantidad de variaciones locales, y eso es especialmente cierto ahora mismo.

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.
segments.tr: Algunas áreas metropolitanas del Cinturón del Sol y del Oeste montañoso que experimentaron un crecimiento explosivo de precios durante la pandemia —mercados como partes de Florida, Texas y Arizona— se han enfriado más y, en algunos casos, han visto modestas reducciones de precios a medida que los patrones de migración posteriores a la pandemia se normalizan y la nueva oferta se pone al día con la demanda.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, muchos mercados en el Noreste y el Medio Oeste, donde el inventario se ha mantenido más ajustado, continúan registrando ganancias anuales más constantes, aunque poco espectaculares.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: Esa divergencia importa para cualquiera que intente leer los titulares nacionales frente a su propio mercado local.

segments.src: A slowing national index doesn't necessarily mean prices are softening in every city, and buyers or sellers should look at local inventory and days-on-market data rather than relying on national averages alone.
segments.tr: Un índice nacional a la baja no significa necesariamente que los precios se estén ablandando en todas las ciudades, y los compradores o vendedores deben mirar el inventario local y los datos de días en el mercado en lugar de depender únicamente de los promedios nacionales.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa hacia el futuro

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: Catorce meses seguidos de crecimiento desacelerado no garantizan hacia dónde se dirigirá el mercado a continuación: podría seguir enfriándose gradualmente, estabilizarse a un ritmo más lento o reaccelerarse si las tasas hipotecarias se reducen significativamente.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: Lo que sí confirma es que la extraordinaria apreciación de precios de los años de la pandemia ha dado paso a un entorno mucho más medido, moldeado en menor medida por guerras de ofertas y más por límites de asequibilidad, costos de financiamiento y dinámicas localizadas de oferta y demanda.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Para los compradores, ese cambio puede significar más margen de negociación y menos situaciones de múltiples ofertas que hace unos años.

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: Para los vendedores, es un recordatorio de que fijar el precio de una casa de manera realista —en lugar de perseguir las comparativas del año pasado— importa más en un mercado que ya no está en pleno auge.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.
segments.tr: Y para la economía en general, un sector de la vivienda que se enfría gradualmente en lugar de fracturarse abruptamente es, según la mayoría de las medidas, el signo de un mercado que encuentra su equilibrio en lugar de uno que se dirige hacia una crisis.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: وفي الوقت نفسه، تستمر العديد من الأسواق في الشمال الشرقي والوسط الغربي، حيث ظل المخزون أكثر إحكاماً، في تسجيل مكاسب سنوية أكثر استقراراً — وإن لم تكن مذهلة.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: هذا التباعد يهم أي شخص يحاول قراءة العناوين الرئيسية الوطنية مقابل سوقه المحلي.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني ذلك للمستقبل

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: أربعة عشر شهراً متتالياً من النمو المتباطئ لا تضمن إلى أين تذهب السوق بعد ذلك — فقد تظل تبرد تدريجياً، أو تستقر بوتيرة أبطأ، أو تسارع مرة أخرى إذا تراجعت أسعار الرهن العقاري بشكل كبير.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: ما يؤكده هو أن ارتفاع الأسعار الاستثنائي لسنوات الجائحة قد فسح المجال لبيئة أكثر قياساً، وهي بيئة يتشكل فيها الأمر بشكل أقل بفعل حروب المزايدة والمزيد بحدود القدرة على تحمل التكاليف، وتكاليف التمويل، وديناميكيات العرض والطلب المحلية.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمشترين، يمكن أن يعني هذا التحول مساحة تفاوض أكبر وحالات عروض متعددة أقل من ذي قبل.

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للبائعين، إنه تذكير بأن تسعير المنزل بشكل واقعي — بدلاً من مطاردة صفقات العام الماضي — يهم أكثر في سوق لم يعد يحقق نتائج ساخنة.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.

fr.title: 14 mois et ce n'est pas fini : ce que les dernières données sur le prix des logements disent du refroidissement du marché immobilier américain

segments.src: ## A Streak Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Une série à surveiller de près

segments.src: The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index — one of the most closely followed gauges of residential real estate in the United States — has now recorded its 14th consecutive month of decelerating annual price growth.
segments.tr: L'indice S&P Cotality Case-Shiller des prix des logements — l'un des indicateurs les plus suivis de l'immobilier résidentiel aux États-Unis — a enregistré son 14e mois consécutif de ralentissement de la croissance annuelle des prix.

segments.src: That doesn't mean home prices are falling across the board; in most metro areas, values are still higher than they were a year ago.
segments.tr: Cela ne signifie pas que les prix des logements chutent à tous les niveaux ; dans la plupart des zones métropolitaines, les valeurs restent supérieures à ce qu'elles étaient il y a un an.

segments.src: What has changed is the *pace*.
segments.tr: Ce qui a changé, c'est le *rythme*.

segments.src: Year-over-year gains have been shrinking steadily since the market's 2023 slowdown, and the latest reading puts growth at its slowest clip in that entire stretch.
segments.tr: Les gains d'une année sur l'autre diminuent régulièrement depuis le ralentissement du marché en 2023, et le dernier relevé affiche la croissance la plus lente de toute cette période.

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: Pour un marché immobilier qui a passé une grande partie de la période pandémique à battre des records, une série de 14 mois de refroidissement constitue une étape notable.

segments.src: It suggests the combination of elevated mortgage rates, affordability strain, and a slow rebuild in housing supply is finally working its way through the numbers in a sustained, not just seasonal, way.
segments.tr: Cela suggère que la combinaison de taux d'intérêt hypothécaires élevés, de tensions sur l'accessibilité financière et d'une lente reconstruction de l'offre de logements finit par se traduire dans les chiffres de manière durable, et pas seulement saisonnière.

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cet indice est important

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: L'indice Case-Shiller suit les ventes répétées des mêmes logements au fil du temps, ce qui en fait une mesure plus fiable des tendances de prix sous-jacentes que de simples aperçus du prix médian des ventes, qui peuvent être biaisés par le type de logements vendus au cours d'un mois donné.

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: Les économistes, les organismes de prêt hypothécaire et la Réserve fédérale le surveillent tous de près, car les prix des logements alimentent directement le patrimoine des ménages, la confiance des consommateurs et — via le calcul du loyer équivalent des propriétaires — les données de l'inflation elles-mêmes.

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: Lorsque le taux de croissance de l'indice ralentit pendant plus d'une année consécutive, cela signale généralement l'une des deux choses suivantes : soit les acheteurs se retirent parce que les logements sont devenus trop chers par rapport aux revenus, soit l'augmentation des coûts d'emprunt exclut une part suffisante de la demande pour que les vendeurs soient contraints de se livrer une concurrence plus vive sur les prix.

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: La plupart des analystes qui suivent ce cycle pointent du doigt un mélange des deux.

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Le contexte des taux d'intérêt hypothécaires

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: Les taux hypothécaires sont restés bien au-dessus des niveaux ultra-bas que les propriétaires ont verrouillés en 2020 et 2021, et cet écart explique une grande partie de ce processus de refroidissement.

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: Des millions de propriétaires actuels détiennent des prêts hypothécaires à des taux inférieurs de plusieurs points à ce qui est disponible aujourd'hui, ce qui les incite peu à vendre et à déménager — un phénomène souvent appelé « effet de verrouillage » ou "lock-in effect".

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: Cela maintient l'offre de revente à un niveau bas, même si la demande des acheteurs s'assouplit, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi les prix ralentissent plutôt que de chuter brutalement dans la plupart des régions.

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, les acheteurs potentiels font face à un calcul de mensualité très différent de celui d'il y a seulement quelques années.

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: Un logement vendu au même prix que l'année dernière peut encore être nettement moins abordable aujourd'hui une fois les coûts de financement pris en compte, et cette réalité mathématique a suffi à écarter une partie des acheteurs potentiels.

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## Les ventes de logements neufs apportent une donnée supplémentaire

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: Le rapport de cette semaine sur les ventes de logements neufs arrive juste à côté de la mise à jour du Case-Shiller, et ensemble, les deux dressent un tableau plus complet du marché.

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: La construction neuve est devenue une soupape de sécurité de plus en plus importante pour la demande des acheteurs, car les constructeurs — contrairement aux propriétaires actuels — ont une forte incitation à vendre, quel que soit l'environnement des taux.

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: Beaucoup ont misé sur des incitations telles que le rachat temporaire de taux d'intérêt et des concessions sur les prix pour maintenir le rythme des contrats, ce qui a aidé les ventes de logements neufs à résister même lorsque le marché global de la revente se refroidit.

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: L'observation simultanée des deux rapports permet de faire la distinction entre un marché qui se rééquilibre simplement après plusieurs années de surchauffe et un marché qui montre de véritables fissures.

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: Jusqu'à présent, la plupart des économistes spécialisés dans le logement décrivent l'environnement actuel comme une normalisation progressive plutôt que comme une répétition de la crise de 2008, soulignant des normes de prêt plus saines et une pénurie structurelle persistante de logements comme des différences clés par rapport à cette époque.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## La divergence régionale est la véritable histoire

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.
segments.tr: Les moyennes nationales peuvent masquer de nombreuses variations locales, et c'est particulièrement vrai en ce moment.

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.
segments.tr: Certaines zones métropolitaines de la Sun Belt et des États des montagnes de l'Ouest qui ont connu une croissance explosive des prix pendant la pandémie — comme certaines régions de Floride, du Texas et de l'Arizona — se sont le plus refroidies et ont, dans certains cas, enregistré de modestes replis de prix à mesure que les flux migratoires post-pandémie se normalisent et que la nouvelle offre rattrape la demande.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, de nombreux marchés du Nord-Est et du Midwest, où les stocks sont restés plus restreints, continuent d'afficher des gains annuels plus stables, à défaut d'être spectaculaires.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: Cette divergence est importante pour quiconque essaie d'interpréter les grands titres nationaux au regard de son propre marché local.

segments.src: A slowing national index doesn't necessarily mean prices are softening in every city, and buyers or sellers should look at local inventory and days-on-market data rather than relying on national averages alone.
segments.tr: Un indice national en ralentissement ne signifie pas nécessairement que les prix fléchissent dans chaque ville, et les acheteurs ou vendeurs devraient examiner les stocks locaux et les données sur le nombre de jours sur le marché plutôt que de se fier uniquement aux moyennes nationales.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour l'avenir

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: Quatorze mois consécutifs de ralentissement de la croissance ne garantissent pas la direction future du marché — il pourrait continuer à se refroidir progressivement, se stabiliser à un rythme plus lent ou réaccélérer si les taux hypothécaires baissent de manière significative.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: Ce que cela confirme, c'est que l'appréciation extraordinaire des prix des années de pandémie a laissé la place à un environnement beaucoup plus mesuré, façonné moins par des surenchères que par des limites d'accessibilité, des coûts de financement et des dynamiques locales d'offre et de demande.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Pour les acheteurs, ce changement peut signifier plus de marge de négociation et moins de situations d'offres multiples qu'il y a quelques années.

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: Pour les vendeurs, c'est un rappel que fixer le prix d'un logement de manière réaliste — plutôt que de courir après les ventes comparables de l'année dernière — compte davantage dans un marché qui ne tourne plus à plein régime.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.
segments.tr: Et pour l'économie dans son ensemble, un secteur résidentiel qui se refroidit progressivement plutôt que de se fissurer brutalement est, selon la plupart des critères, le signe d'un marché qui trouve ses marques plutôt que d'un marché qui s'achemine vers une crise.

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: O índice Case-Shiller rastreia vendas repetidas das mesmas casas ao longo do tempo, o que o torna uma medida mais confiável das tendências de preços subjacentes do que simples instantâneos de preço médio de venda, que podem ser distorcidos por quais casas são vendidas em um determinado mês.

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: Economistas, credores hipotecários e o Federal Reserve acompanham tudo de perto porque os preços das casas alimentam diretamente a riqueza das famílias, a confiança do consumidor e — por meio dos cálculos de aluguel equivalente dos proprietários — os próprios dados de inflação.

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: Quando a taxa de crescimento do índice desacelera por mais de um ano seguido, isso geralmente sinaliza uma de duas coisas: ou os compradores estão recuando porque as casas se tornaram muito caras em relação à renda, ou os custos de empréstimos mais altos estão excluindo demanda suficiente a ponto de os vendedores terem que competir mais agressivamente no preço.

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: A maioria dos analistas que acompanham este ciclo aponta para uma combinação de ambos.

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## O cenário das taxas de hipoteca

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: As taxas de hipoteca permaneceram bem acima dos níveis ultrabaixos que os proprietários garantiram durante 2020 e 2021, e essa diferença está fazendo grande parte do trabalho por trás dessa tendência de resfriamento.

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: Milhões de proprietários atuais estão com hipotecas com taxas vários pontos abaixo do que está disponível hoje, dando-lhes pouco incentivo para vender e se mudar — um fenômeno frequentemente chamado de "efeito de bloqueio" (lock-in effect).

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: Isso mantém o estoque de revenda restrito mesmo com a demanda dos compradores diminuindo, o que é parte do motivo pelo qual os preços estão desacelerando em vez de cair drasticamente na maioria das regiões.

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, potenciais compradores enfrentam um cálculo de pagamento mensal que parece muito diferente do que era há apenas alguns anos.

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: Uma casa com o mesmo preço do ano passado ainda pode ser significativamente menos acessível hoje quando os custos de financiamento são levados em consideração, e essa conta tem sido suficiente para deixar de lado uma parte dos potenciais compradores.

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## As vendas de casas novas adicionam outro ponto de dados

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: O relatório de vendas de casas novas desta semana chega junto com a atualização do Case-Shiller, e juntos os dois pintam um quadro mais completo do mercado.

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: A nova construção tornou-se uma válvula de escape cada vez mais importante para a demanda dos compradores, já que os construtores — ao contrário dos proprietários existentes — têm forte incentivo para vender, independentemente do ambiente de taxas.

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: Muitos recorreram a incentivos como redução de taxas de hipoteca e concessões de preços para manter os contratos em movimento, o que ajudou as vendas de casas novas a se sustentarem mesmo com o mercado de revenda mais amplo esfriando.

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: Observar os dois relatórios juntos ajuda a distinguir entre um mercado que está apenas se reequilibrando após vários anos superaquecidos e um que está mostrando rachaduras genuínas.

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: Até agora, a maioria dos economistas do setor imobiliário descreve o ambiente atual como uma normalização gradual, em vez de uma repetição da crise de 2008, apontando para padrões de empréstimo mais saudáveis e uma escassez estrutural persistente de casas como as principais diferenças daquela época.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## A divergência regional é a verdadeira história

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.
segments.tr: As médias nacionais podem obscurecer muitas variações locais, e isso é especialmente verdadeiro agora.

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.
segments.tr: Algumas áreas metropolitanas do Sun Belt e do Mountain West que viram um crescimento explosivo de preços durante a pandemia — mercados como partes da Flórida, Texas e Arizona — esfriaram mais e, em alguns casos, viram recuos modestos nos preços à medida que os padrões de migração pós-pandemia se normalizam e a nova oferta alcança a demanda.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, muitos mercados no Nordeste e no Centro-Oeste, onde o estoque permaneceu mais restrito, continuam a registrar ganhos anuais mais estáveis — embora não espetaculares.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: Essa divergência é importante para qualquer pessoa que tente ler as manchetes nacionais em relação ao seu próprio mercado local.

segments.src: A slowing national index doesn't necessarily mean prices are softening in every city, and buyers or sellers should look at local inventory and days-on-market data rather than relying on national averages alone.
segments.tr: Um índice nacional em desaceleração não significa necessariamente que os preços estão caindo em todas as cidades, e compradores ou vendedores devem observar os dados de estoque local e dias no mercado em vez de confiar apenas nas médias nacionais.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa daqui para frente

segments.src: Fourteen straight months of decelerating growth doesn't guarantee where the market goes next — it could keep gradually cooling, stabilize at a slower pace, or reaccelerate if mortgage rates ease meaningfully.
segments.tr: Quatorze meses seguidos de crescimento em desaceleração não garantem para onde o mercado irá a seguir — ele pode continuar esfriando gradualmente, estabilizar em um ritmo mais lento ou reacelerar se as taxas de hipoteca diminuírem significativamente.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: O que isso confirma é que a extraordinária valorização dos preços dos anos de pandemia deu lugar a um ambiente muito mais comedido, moldado menos por guerras de lances e mais por limites de acessibilidade, custos de financiamento e dinâmicas localizadas de oferta e demanda.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.

segments.src: For sellers, it's a reminder that pricing a home realistically — rather than chasing last year's comps — matters more in a market that's no longer running hot.
segments.tr: Para os vendedores, é um lembrete de que precificar uma casa de forma realista — em vez de perseguir as comparações do ano passado — importa mais em um mercado que não está mais aquecido.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.

in.title: 14 Bulan dan Terus Berlanjut: Apa Kata Data Harga Rumah Terbaru Tentang Pasar Perumahan Amerika yang Mendingin

segments.src: ## A Streak Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Tren yang Layak Diperhatikan

segments.src: The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Index — one of the most closely followed gauges of residential real estate in the United States — has now recorded its 14th consecutive month of decelerating annual price growth.
segments.tr: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller Home Price Index — salah satu tolok ukur real estat residensial yang paling banyak diikuti di Amerika Serikat — kini telah mencatat bulan ke-14 berturut-turut perlambatan pertumbuhan harga tahunan.

segments.src: That doesn't mean home prices are falling across the board; in most metro areas, values are still higher than they were a year ago.
segments.tr: Itu tidak berarti harga rumah turun secara menyeluruh; di sebagian besar wilayah metropolitan, nilainya masih lebih tinggi daripada setahun yang lalu.

segments.src: What has changed is the *pace*.
segments.tr: Yang berubah adalah *kecepatannya*.

segments.src: Year-over-year gains have been shrinking steadily since the market's 2023 slowdown, and the latest reading puts growth at its slowest clip in that entire stretch.
segments.tr: Keuntungan dari tahun ke tahun terus menyusut sejak perlambatan pasar tahun 2023, dan data terbaru menunjukkan pertumbuhan pada tingkat paling lambat dalam seluruh periode tersebut.

segments.src: For a housing market that spent much of the pandemic era setting records, a 14-month streak of cooling is a notable milestone.
segments.tr: Bagi pasar perumahan yang menghabiskan sebagian besar era pandemi dengan mencetak rekor, tren pendinginan selama 14 bulan adalah tonggak sejarah yang patut diperhatikan.

segments.src: It suggests the combination of elevated mortgage rates, affordability strain, and a slow rebuild in housing supply is finally working its way through the numbers in a sustained, not just seasonal, way.
segments.tr: Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa kombinasi suku bunga hipotek yang tinggi, tekanan keterjangkauan, dan pemulihan pasokan perumahan yang lambat akhirnya mulai berdampak pada angka-angka secara berkelanjutan, bukan hanya musiman.

segments.src: ## Why the Index Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Indeks Ini Penting

segments.src: The Case-Shiller index tracks repeat sales of the same homes over time, which makes it a more reliable measure of underlying price trends than simple median-sale-price snapshots that can be skewed by which homes happen to sell in a given month.
segments.tr: Indeks Case-Shiller melacak penjualan berulang rumah yang sama dari waktu ke waktu, yang menjadikannya ukuran tren harga dasar yang lebih andal daripada sekadar potret harga jual median yang bisa terdistorsi oleh rumah mana yang kebetulan terjual pada bulan tertentu.

segments.src: Economists, mortgage lenders, and the Federal Reserve all watch it closely because home prices feed directly into household wealth, consumer confidence, and — through owners' equivalent rent calculations — inflation data itself.
segments.tr: Para ekonom, pemberi pinjaman hipotek, dan Federal Reserve semuanya mengamatinya dengan cermat karena harga rumah berdampak langsung pada kekayaan rumah tangga, kepercayaan konsumen, dan — melalui perhitungan sewa setara pemilik — data inflasi itu sendiri.

segments.src: When the index's growth rate slows for over a year straight, it typically signals one of two things: either buyers are pulling back because homes have become too expensive relative to incomes, or higher borrowing costs are pricing out enough demand that sellers have to compete harder on price.
segments.tr: Ketika tingkat pertumbuhan indeks melambat selama lebih dari setahun berturut-turut, biasanya ini menandakan salah satu dari dua hal: pembeli menarik diri karena rumah menjadi terlalu mahal dibandingkan dengan pendapatan, atau biaya pinjaman yang lebih tinggi mengurangi permintaan sehingga penjual harus bersaing lebih keras dalam hal harga.

segments.src: Most analysts following this cycle point to a mix of both.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar analis yang mengikuti siklus ini menunjukkan kombinasi dari keduanya.

segments.src: ## The Mortgage Rate Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Latar Belakang Suku Bunga Hipotek

segments.src: Mortgage rates have remained well above the ultra-low levels homeowners locked in during 2020 and 2021, and that gap is doing a lot of the work behind this cooling trend.
segments.tr: Suku bunga hipotek tetap jauh di atas tingkat sangat rendah yang dikunci oleh pemilik rumah selama tahun 2020 dan 2021, dan kesenjangan itu menjadi faktor utama di balik tren pendinginan ini.

segments.src: Millions of existing homeowners are sitting on mortgages with rates several points below what's available today, giving them little incentive to sell and move — a phenomenon often called the "lock-in effect."
segments.tr: Jutaan pemilik rumah yang ada saat ini memegang hipotek dengan suku bunga beberapa poin di bawah apa yang tersedia saat ini, sehingga mereka tidak memiliki banyak insentif untuk menjual dan pindah — sebuah fenomena yang sering disebut sebagai "efek penguncian" (lock-in effect).

segments.src: That keeps resale inventory tight even as buyer demand softens, which is part of why prices are decelerating rather than dropping sharply in most regions.
segments.tr: Hal itu menjaga persediaan rumah bekas tetap ketat bahkan saat permintaan pembeli melemah, yang merupakan bagian dari alasan mengapa harga melambat daripada turun tajam di sebagian besar wilayah.

segments.src: Meanwhile, prospective buyers face a monthly payment calculus that looks very different than it did just a few years ago.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, calon pembeli menghadapi kalkulasi pembayaran bulanan yang terlihat sangat berbeda dibandingkan beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.src: A home priced the same as last year can still be meaningfully less affordable today once financing costs are factored in, and that math has been enough to sideline a portion of would-be purchasers.
segments.tr: Rumah dengan harga yang sama seperti tahun lalu bisa menjadi jauh kurang terjangkau saat ini setelah biaya pembiayaan diperhitungkan, dan perhitungan itu cukup untuk membuat sebagian calon pembeli mundur.

segments.src: ## New-Home Sales Add Another Data Point
segments.tr: ## Penjualan Rumah Baru Menambah Poin Data Lain

segments.src: This week's new-home-sales report lands right alongside the Case-Shiller update, and together the two paint a more complete picture of the market.
segments.tr: Laporan penjualan rumah baru minggu ini muncul bersamaan dengan pembaruan Case-Shiller, dan keduanya bersama-sama memberikan gambaran pasar yang lebih lengkap.

segments.src: New construction has become an increasingly important release valve for buyer demand, since builders — unlike existing homeowners — have strong incentive to sell regardless of the rate environment.
segments.tr: Konstruksi baru telah menjadi katup pelepas yang semakin penting bagi permintaan pembeli, karena pengembang — tidak seperti pemilik rumah yang ada — memiliki insentif kuat untuk menjual terlepas dari lingkungan suku bunga.

segments.src: Many have leaned on incentives like mortgage-rate buydowns and price concessions to keep contracts moving, which has helped new-home sales hold up even as the broader resale market cools.
segments.tr: Banyak yang mengandalkan insentif seperti penurunan suku bunga hipotek dan potongan harga untuk menjaga kontrak tetap berjalan, yang telah membantu penjualan rumah baru bertahan bahkan saat pasar rumah bekas yang lebih luas mendingin.

segments.src: Watching the two reports together helps distinguish between a market that's merely rebalancing after several overheated years and one that's showing genuine cracks.
segments.tr: Mengamati kedua laporan tersebut bersama-sama membantu membedakan antara pasar yang hanya menyeimbangkan kembali setelah beberapa tahun yang terlalu panas dan pasar yang menunjukkan keretakan nyata.

segments.src: So far, most housing economists describe the current environment as a gradual normalization rather than a repeat of the 2008 downturn, pointing to healthier lending standards and a persistent structural shortage of homes as key differences from that era.
segments.tr: Sejauh ini, sebagian besar ekonom perumahan menggambarkan lingkungan saat ini sebagai normalisasi bertahap daripada pengulangan penurunan tahun 2008, dengan menunjuk pada standar pinjaman yang lebih sehat dan kekurangan rumah struktural yang persisten sebagai perbedaan utama dari era tersebut.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story
segments.tr: ## Perbedaan Regional Adalah Cerita Sebenarnya

segments.tr: Rata-rata nasional bisa mengaburkan banyak variasi lokal, dan itu sangat benar saat ini.

segments.tr: Beberapa wilayah metropolitan di Sun Belt dan Mountain West yang mengalami pertumbuhan harga eksplosif selama pandemi — pasar seperti sebagian Florida, Texas, dan Arizona — telah paling banyak mendingin dan, dalam beberapa kasus, mengalami penurunan harga moderat seiring normalisasi pola migrasi pasca-pandemi dan pasokan baru yang mengejar permintaan.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, banyak pasar di Timur Laut dan Midwest, di mana persediaan tetap lebih ketat, terus mencatat keuntungan tahunan yang lebih stabil — meskipun tidak spektakuler.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.
segments.tr: Perbedaan itu penting bagi siapa pun yang mencoba membaca berita utama nasional terhadap pasar lokal mereka sendiri.

segments.src: A slowing national index doesn't necessarily mean prices are softening in every city, and buyers or sellers should look at local inventory and days-on-market data rather than relying on national averages alone.
segments.tr: Indeks nasional yang melambat tidak serta merta berarti harga melunak di setiap kota, dan pembeli atau penjual harus melihat data persediaan lokal dan hari-di-pasar daripada hanya mengandalkan rata-rata nasional.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya ke Depan

segments.tr: Empat belas bulan pertumbuhan yang melambat berturut-turut tidak menjamin ke mana arah pasar selanjutnya — pasar bisa terus mendingin secara bertahap, stabil pada kecepatan yang lebih lambat, atau kembali meningkat jika suku bunga hipotek turun secara signifikan.

segments.src: What it does confirm is that the extraordinary price appreciation of the pandemic years has given way to a much more measured environment, one shaped less by bidding wars and more by affordability limits, financing costs, and localized supply-and-demand dynamics.
segments.tr: Yang dikonfirmasi adalah bahwa apresiasi harga yang luar biasa selama tahun-tahun pandemi telah memberi jalan bagi lingkungan yang jauh lebih terukur, yang dibentuk bukan oleh perang penawaran tetapi oleh batas keterjangkauan, biaya pembiayaan, dan dinamika penawaran-permintaan lokal.

segments.src: For buyers, that shift can mean more negotiating room and fewer multiple-offer situations than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Bagi pembeli, pergeseran itu bisa berarti lebih banyak ruang negosiasi dan lebih sedikit situasi penawaran ganda dibandingkan beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.tr: Bagi penjual, ini adalah pengingat bahwa menetapkan harga rumah secara realistis — daripada mengejar perbandingan harga tahun lalu — lebih penting di pasar yang tidak lagi berjalan panas.

segments.src: And for the economy at large, a housing sector that's cooling gradually rather than cracking abruptly is, by most measures, a sign of a market finding its footing rather than one heading toward crisis.

segments.src: ## Regional Divergence Is the Real Story

segments.src: National averages can obscure a lot of local variation, and that's especially true right now.

segments.src: Some Sun Belt and Mountain West metros that saw explosive price growth during the pandemic — markets like parts of Florida, Texas, and Arizona — have cooled the most and, in some cases, seen modest price pullbacks as post-pandemic migration patterns normalize and new supply catches up with demand.

segments.src: Meanwhile, many markets in the Northeast and Midwest, where inventory has stayed tighter, continue to post steadier — if unspectacular — annual gains.

segments.src: That divergence matters for anyone trying to read national headlines against their own local market.

segments.src: ## What It Means Going Forward
segments.tr: ## 今後の意味
